failure_modes.evidence: Summary 1: 'they do not contain information about "The Land" (2016), its producer Mark Cobb, or any actress who appeared in both films.' Summary 2: 'The passages provided do not contain any information about the 2016 film "The Land," its producer Mark Cobb, the 2008 film "Death Race," or any actress appearing in either film.' failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Query 2: 'The Land 2016 film producer Mark Cobb cast actress' — this is an unstructured keyword soup bundling multiple targets (film title, producer name, cast, actress) without clean entity separation.

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Query 2: 'The Land 2016 film producer Mark Cobb cast actress' and Query 3: 'Death Race 2008 film, The Land 2016 film, Mark Cobb producer' both target the same entities (The Land 2016, Mark Cobb, Death Race) without substantive advancement. Neither query retrieved information about 'The Land' 2016 film, yet the third query still searches for it in nearly identical form.

failure_modes.name: Insufficient_Retrieved_Evidence
failure_modes.evidence: Summary 1 names the missing entity: 'they do not contain information about "The Land" (2016), its producer Mark Cobb'. Query 3 explicitly targets it: 'Death Race 2008 film, The Land 2016 film, Mark Cobb producer'. Despite this well-formed query targeting the named gap, retrieval across all three hops never returns a document about the 2016 film 'The Land' or its producer Mark Cobb — a corpus/retriever coverage gap.
